item: Qualification integrity: attempt timestamps, a live curated stamp reads curated, and boot withdraws (never re-admits) inversions with an uncapped revert record (diagnostics rank 14, C52)
status: SHIPPED (unit-tested with fakes; field effect appears at each instance's next boot)
key_paths: src/catalog/qualification_integrity.py; src/backup/import_reports.py; src/catalog/qualification_export.py; src/discovery/source_trail.py; src/api/main.py; scripts/repair_qualification_inversions.py; tests/test_qualification_auto_repair.py; docs/ledger/OPEN_QUEUE.md
summary: qualification-integrity.json gains last_attempt_at, last_judging_attempt_at and the 24h attempt counts, plus every automatic repair (repaired_total, name, time, prior status). The export and the source provenance read a row whose LIVE stamp is oo-curated-catalog-1 as curated even with copied-in judging history (curated_stamp_with_judging_history counts them). At deferred boot, local DB only (airplane mode included), sources live-not-disqualified whose newest judging attempt says disqualified go back to disqualified; the opposite direction stays operator-run. Every repair is kept with the status and stamp it replaced in app_state (one key per run plus an index, no cap, never merged on restore); scripts/repair_qualification_inversions.py --revert-repairs undoes them and holds the domain out of later repairs. RC06 note recorded in OPEN_QUEUE. Also: the import report counts a catalogue-stamped row that merely received the same measured qualified as confirmed (not as a newly qualified source) and reports rows holding only the catalogue stamp apart from verdicts reached or adopted here.
